candidates.title: Quoted artifact paths truncate at spaces
candidates.expected_behavior: Preserve the full quoted sandbox path in the persistent artifact reference.
candidates.observed_behavior: The production extractor stores /mnt/user-data/outputs/quarterly instead of the full quarterly report.txt path.
candidates.agent_recovery: Literal full-path fallback read returned CHECKPOINT-7303. Agent then retried newly emitted truncated handles; no final response before GraphRecursionError at limit 100.
candidates.control: No-space handle resolved correctly; readback and final response succeeded.

candidates.title: Duplicate SQL columns silently lose data in JSON export
candidates.expected_behavior: Reject ambiguous duplicate JSON keys or preserve both source values explicitly; never silently discard a value.
candidates.observed_behavior: The native exporter reports success but turns two id columns with values 1 and 2 into a single id value 2.
candidates.agent_recovery: Agent diagnosed native JSON value loss and additionally demonstrated CSV/Markdown preserve both values. No final response before GraphRecursionError at limit 100.
candidates.control: Distinct SQL aliases preserved both values in JSON.

candidates.title: Podcast CLI returns success after generation failure
candidates.expected_behavior: Return a nonzero process status when podcast generation fails.
candidates.observed_behavior: The native CLI reports missing credentials and produces no MP3, but exits 0; argparse control exits 2.
candidates.agent_recovery: Agent checked stderr and MP3 absence, correctly reported generation failure despite exit code 0. Diagnostic task completed; no audio generation recovery attempted.
candidates.control: No-argument native CLI returned argparse exit code 2.
